title: Flow Plugin Pilot Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: W1 pilot of the CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE master ticket (26/08/05). Merge the 🌊️flow plugin's 8 Rust crates (bundle + app facade + engine/dsl/op/pack/protocol/ui modules) into ONE crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌊️flow/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ with the full taxonomy source tree (🗿️artifacts/🌊️flow/{component,diff,op,dsl,pack,spr,engine}, 🎛️apps/🌊️flow/{component,config,terminology,commands,modes,panels}) wired from a plugin-root 📦️lib.rs via explicit #[path] mod declarations. Decompose FlowCommand with the new app_commands! macro, stitch the manifest from per-node definition() fns using the new AppBuilder .mode_def/.window_kind_def/.panel_tab_def passthroughs, preserve wire format exactly, keep every existing test. Then write 📋️TEMPLATE.md into the master ticket folder documenting the reusable recipe for the other 31 plugins. Never touch root Cargo.toml / launch.json / registry script / other plugins — report the registrar handoff lines instead.
summary:
W1 pilot of the crate-consolidation restructure: 🌊️flow's 8 Rust crates (bundle + app facade + engine/dsl/op/pack/protocol/ui) merged into ONE crate `semio-s-plugin-flow` at `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌊️flow/📦️packages/🦀️rust/`, with a 34-component taxonomy source tree under the plugin root wired from `📦️lib.rs` by explicit full-path `#[path]` declarations.

Structure: `🗿️artifacts/🌊️flow/{🦀️component,🔺️diff,🔧️op,🗣️dsl,🎒️pack,📡️spr,⚙️engine}` (📡️protocol renamed to 📡️spr; the FlowCommand enum moved out of it to app level) and `🎛️apps/🌊️flow/{🦀️component,🦀️config,🦀️terminology, 🎮️commands×12, 🎭️modes/{✏️edit,🧬️generate}, 📌️panels×3}`. `DocumentApp::handle` is now two lines (lock the eval session, `command.dispatch(...)`); the manifest is stitched from per-node `definition()` fns through the W0 `.mode_def()`/`.window_kind_def()`/`.panel_tab_def()` passthroughs; the 41-variant `FlowCommand` is rebuilt with `app_commands!`.

Wire format proven unchanged: a pre-migration dump of `print_op | len | hex` for every command variant diffs byte-identically against the post-migration dump (both saved in this ticket folder). Two permanent guards were added — a per-row "printed line starts with the row's wire keyword" law and a hex-pinned test for the `Option`-field rows.

Verification (all via a temporary nested `[workspace]` overlay, since the new crate cannot be a workspace member while the same-named old bundle crate still is — overlay removed at handoff): `cargo check` clean, `cargo check --target wasm32-wasip2` clean, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean, `cargo test` 83/83 green (baseline across the 8 old crates was 44), `cargo build --target wasm32-wasip2` + `jco transpile` succeed, taxonomy audit clean, dependency-cruiser clean. The 8 old crate dirs are deleted; the root workspace is red on exactly those 8 dangling member lines until the registrar pass (see 📋️registrar-handoff.md).

Four additive framework gaps found and fixed in `semio-framework-plugin`: `app_commands!` gained a keyed row form (`"commandId" as "wire-key"` — the original single literal silently rewrote the wire format), a `ctx = <T>` dispatch-context arm, and `$(#[$meta])*` attribute passthrough; and `testkit::assert_constitutional_crates` (run by `semio_plugin!`'s generated sanity test) is now taxonomy-aware so a migrated plugin passes its own `cargo test`.

Also wrote `📋️TEMPLATE.md` into the master ticket folder — the ordered, copy-pasteable recipe for the remaining 31 plugins, including the `#[path = "."]` mechanics, the Cargo.toml union + isolated-verification trick, the command-decomposition rules (notably: every payload struct needs `#[dsl(keyword = ...)]` or the op prints with no keyword and fails to re-parse), the verification sequence with its known clippy fallout, and the registrar handoff contract.
